guides.title: Show template diagnostics and completions in the editor
guides.summary: Enable the language service plugin so editors report template problems and complete markup inside html templates.
guides.markdown:
Enable the plugin in tsconfig.json with `"plugins": [{ "name": "@cossackframework/typescript-plugin" }]`. TypeScript's JavaScript server (tsserver) loads it by that name with require() and passes its own compiler module, so the plugin uses the editor's TypeScript, not a copy of its own. In VS Code, set `"typescript.tsserver.pluginPaths": ["."]` so the bundled TypeScript finds the plugin in the project's node_modules; generated applications ship this setting. The TypeScript 7 native compiler does not run language service plugins, so builds rely on `cossack check templates` and the Vite plugin.

The plugin wraps the language service. Semantic diagnostics gain the template errors and warnings of `cossack check templates`, suggestion diagnostics gain its hints, and completions inside `html` and `svg` templates offer tag names, end tags, attributes, `@events`, `.properties`, `?booleans`, enumerated values and component tag props. Inside a `${...}` binding, TypeScript's own completions apply. Every other language service method is the original one. Without a program for a file the plugin adds nothing.
